title: Count Pairs With Absolute Difference K
description: Count index pairs `i < j` such that `abs(nums[i] - nums[j]) == k`. Equal values at different indices form a valid pair when `k` is zero. Input: `nums`, `k`. Output: the pair count.
hints: Keep a running total or frequency count rather than recomputing over all prefixes.
Test repeated values, zeros, and minimum-size inputs.
